authorInfo.bio:
Mrs. (Martha) Blackford (1775–1846) wrote The Eskdale Herd-boy
A Scottish Tale for the Instruction and Amusement of Young People. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
